name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $58,700 on 22 Nov, 32% below its high and 9.5% lower on the week; no de-peg or exchange failure found
state: Bitcoin was near $58,711 early on 22 Nov, 32.2% below its 52-week high of about $86,600, 9.5% lower on the week and 25% lower over a month, with a worst day of -5.0% in five sessions (Yahoo Finance). The drawdown is inside the 25–45% Watch band; searches to 22 Nov found no major stablecoin de-peg or top-10 exchange failure.
for_you: Crypto prices are in a deep, volatile slide. Holders are exposed to further sharp moves; crypto assets are generally not covered by deposit protection schemes.
why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
